$comment: Values the API's Lambda bundles (apps/api) and the CDK app (infra/cdk) must agree on. Read by apps/api/src/lambda-contract.ts and infra/cdk/src/lib/lambda-contract.ts; change them here only.

environment.$comment: Variables each function receives (infra sets exactly these; the bundle import-check runs each handler with exactly these). SITE_ORIGIN is added to the api only with a custom domain. SPEECH_ENABLED and SPEECH_ENGINE come from infra/cdk/config/production.json `speech` (voice calls: whether the API may use Amazon Polly and Transcribe, and the Polly engine). The MEDIA_* variables come from its `media` (the vEIR's digital twin: the face and cloned-voice vendors, off by default; docs/runbooks/avatars.md). insights (the operator's read-only insights function) needs only the common variables.

worker.$comment: Bodies of the jobs-queue messages the EventBridge Scheduler schedules send (infra app-stack.ts). dailyMaintenanceMessage: once a day, ephemeral-session expiry and redaction (a maintenance job). distillSweepMessage: on the distillation schedule when enabled (config/production.json distillation), the worker distils a bounded batch of idle, undistilled conversations inline (it never enqueues).
